This panel shows that the bearing A→B is 090° and the back bearing B→A is 270°. Using the same method, calculate the back bearing Q→P when the bearing from P to Q is 062°.
items.canonical_answer:
Because 062° is less than 180°, add 180°: 062° + 180° = 242°. The answer lies in the south-west quadrant, opposite the north-east direction of Q from P, as the panel's 090°/270° pair shows.

![Direction panel annotated with bearings 090°, 000° and 045°, reverse B→A 270° and the compass circle in degrees](../../../assets/images/ITEM-6137-4.2-016-INTERP-answer.png)
marking_guidance: 1 mark for the method: add 180° because the bearing is below 180°.
1 mark for the answer 242.
1 mark for the degree unit in three-figure form, 242°.

![Original 1:50,000 training map of an invented area with title, full key, 1 km grid, grid-north arrow, contours at 10 m interval, roads, river, cultivation, school at D and clinic at C](../../../assets/images/ITEM-6137-4.2-002-INTERP-question.png)

![Measurement panel at 1:50,000: straight A–B line, curved A–B road, square ABCD, a 1 cm square, spot heights A 1,500 m and B 1,540 m, a 0–3 km scale bar and a section from A to B](../../../assets/images/ITEM-6137-4.2-008-INTERP-question.png)

Use this original 1:50,000 training map with full key and grid-north arrow. A is at local metre position (2000,2000), B (4000,2000), C (4000,4000), D (2000,4000); x east/y north. A and B have spot heights 1,500 and 1,540 m. School is keyed at D and clinic at C. The map’s straight A–B length is four centimetres at intended size.
(a) Name the service supplied by the clinic. [1]
(b) Calculate straight A–B ground distance from the scale. [2]
(c) Describe three distinct mapped relationships involving position, area or relief. [3]
(d) What judgement is supported about the claim “the road symbol proves frequent affordable public transport”? [1]
items.canonical_answer:
(a) Healthcare. (b) Four centimetres at 500 metres per centimetre gives 2,000 metres or two kilometres. (c) B is east of A; C/D lie north of B/A respectively; the ABCD square has four km² area; B is forty metres higher than A. Credit three distinct map-supported relationships. (d) Reject the service-frequency claim: a road locates a connection, while operation and affordability are not supplied.

![Training map annotated with the P01 answers: healthcare, A–B 2 km, mapped relationships, road claim rejected](../../../assets/images/ITEM-6137-4.2-P01-VIS-6137-4.2-01-answer.png)

![Measurement panel annotated: straight A–B 2 km, road 3 km, square 4 km², 1 cm square 0.25 km², rise 40 m (1:50)](../../../assets/images/ITEM-6137-4.2-008-INTERP-answer.png)
marking_guidance: (a) 1 A mark for healthcare.
(b) 2 B marks for the scale method and correct distance/unit.
(c) 3 B marks for distinct resource-based spatial/area/relief patterns with supporting map evidence.
(d) 1 C mark for a supported mapped-connection/service judgement.
